answer: In the blue hour the crevasse-edge warden kneels at the snow bridge, taps the span with the probe and plants the warning wand at each end before the mules cross. The bridge is trusted because of Ridge piton tester hut writ: a writ piton testers audit after hut sled checks. The ledge taps the span, the anchor plants the wand, the yarrow leads the mules. Hiding a hollow span takes 5261 false probes and 5261 false wands to conceal.
